newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X says director Francisco resigns.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X says director Francisco resigns.

text.p: Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd said on Friday Rolando C. Francisco has resigned as a director, officer and employee of Bre-X and its sister companies Bresea Resources Ltd and Bro-X Minerals Ltd.
Francisco's resignation came a day after Bre-X, Bresea and Bro-X were granted court protection from their creditors.
Bre-X said in a statement Francisco's resignation was effective today.
Francisco joined directors Hugh Lyons and Paul Kavanagh who resigned from the Bre-X group of companies on Wednesday.
Bre-X's chief of exploration, John Felderhof, resigned from the Calgary, Alberta-based company on Thursday at the request of Bre-X.
